verifies_phase: Workbench v0.2 — Ingest Mode UI with PROV-O readiness acceptance gate
depends_on: Phase D1 + D2 complete and certified (178/178 scenarios). Workbench v0.1 Converse + Export modes functional.

locked_decisions.W-D-1: Ingest mode is a workspace, not a wizard. Panels navigable non-linearly. State persists across mode switches. (Invariant W-1)
locked_decisions.W-D-2: UI never simplifies analyst's evidence. Fingerprint breakdowns show all six dimensions with weights; FailureTraces show Prolog traces verbatim; margins displayed to three decimals. (Invariant W-2)
locked_decisions.W-D-3: Invariants from FANDAWS / D1 / D2 specs are visibly enforced at UI layer per §8.5 catalog. (Invariant W-3)
locked_decisions.W-D-4: localStorage persistence for IngestionSession records, staging records, merge records, disambiguation records, quarantine records, and analyst justifications. Sessions survive page reloads.
locked_decisions.W-D-5: Six-panel Ingest mode structure: Sessions, Upload, Phase 1 Review, Phase 2 Review, Phase 3 Review, Session Summary.
locked_decisions.W-D-6: Single active session for review at a time. Session ID displayed in top bar of every Ingest panel.
locked_decisions.W-D-7: Ingest mode calls existing D1/D2 pipeline functions directly. No new API layer. UI is a thin rendering layer over existing pipeline state.
locked_decisions.W-D-8: Acceptance gate is AC-W-PROV-O: Aaron can complete a full PROV-O Pass 1 through the UI with artifacts sufficient to populate report template through §7 without manual JSON extraction.
locked_decisions.W-D-9: Tau Prolog execution runs in browser thread for v0.2. Web Worker migration deferred to v0.3 if performance requires.
locked_decisions.W-D-10: Accessibility baseline: keyboard navigation, color-plus-icon status, copy-to-clipboard on monospace. Full WCAG AA audit deferred to v0.3.
locked_decisions.W-D-11: No automated browser testing harness in v0.2. Manual browser testing + Node.js headless where applicable. Playwright/Cypress deferred to v0.3.
locked_decisions.W-D-12: No delete action for sessions. VD-5 preserved. Implementations MAY provide 'clear all sessions' for test hygiene with destructive confirmation.
locked_decisions.W-D-13: Implementation sequencing: mode switcher → Sessions/Upload → Phase 1 Review → Phase 3 Review → Phase 2 Review → Session Summary. Phase 2 built last due to highest complexity.
locked_decisions.W-D-14: PROV-O test execution is the final acceptance test. v0.2 is not 'shipped' until Pass 1 executes end-to-end through the UI.
locked_decisions.clarification_nowizard: The workspace-not-wizard distinction matters because ingestion is iterative. Analyst may switch to Converse mid-disambiguation to consult BFO semantics, then return. A wizard would fight this workflow.
locked_decisions.clarification_edgecanonical: All execution remains edge-canonical. File uploads via FileReader. Persistence via localStorage. No backend.
locked_decisions.clarification_invariant_visibility: Visible invariant enforcement at UI is not just UX polish. It is what makes a calibration study's invariant audit (Report §6.1) doable without opening a debugger.
locked_decisions.W-D-15: File size cap at 1MB on upload content (W-3.9). localStorage quota probe before session creation (W-3.10). Together these prevent QuotaExceededError mid-save. Threshold is conservative relative to browser 5MB quota — reserves headroom for derived session records.
locked_decisions.W-D-16: Pagination/virtualization on Phase 1 Review and Phase 2 Review tables (W-4.10, W-5.15). Default page size 100. Global sort and filter across pages. Invisible UI for small ontologies (≤100 rows). Baseline built into v0.2 even though PROV-O does not require it, to prevent retrofit pain when subsequent calibration-series tests use larger ontologies.
locked_decisions.W-D-17: Phase 3 evaluation loop yields to browser render thread between chunks (W-5.14, §12.1). Implementation: setTimeout(fn, 0) or requestAnimationFrame between 10-25 axiom evaluations. Progress indicator animates with per-axiom counter (W-5.16). Web Worker migration remains deferred to v0.3.
locked_decisions.W-D-18: Bundle export header carries schemaVersion (semver), workbenchVersion, fandawsVersion, generatedAt (W-7.7, W-7.10). v0.2 ships with schemaVersion '1.0'. Semver discipline: MAJOR for removals/renames, MINOR for additions. Enables calibration-series cross-test comparison tooling in v0.3+ to parse bundles from all prior tests.
locked_decisions.clarification_series_scope: v0.2's acceptance gate (AC-W-PROV-O) is the PROV-O test. The pagination, yielding, and schemaVersion infrastructure is built from day one to support the planned calibration-study series (CCO modules, IOF, GO subsets, Schema.org, larger tests) without requiring retrofit. v0.2 does NOT commit to large-ontology support — that is v0.3+.
locked_decisions.W-D-19: owl:imports declarations recorded in IngestionSession metadata (declaredImports field) but NOT followed during ingestion (W-3.11, W-IM-1). Only directly-declared classes and properties in the uploaded file are treated as candidates. References to entities in imported ontologies appear as external IRIs handled by existing pipeline machinery. Full import-closure handling deferred to v0.3.
locked_decisions.W-D-20: Tau Prolog bundled into v0.2 output via esbuild at build time (W-TP-1). No runtime CDN fetch, no script-tag global attached to window.pl, no JavaScript harness substitute for the Prolog engine. The v0.2 bundle includes Tau Prolog as an ES module; the Node.js test harness continues to use CJS require-path via existing pattern. Both paths run the same pinned Tau Prolog version. Substituting a JS simulacrum for v0.2 would invalidate every D2 AVC scenario's engine-authenticity guarantee (AC-D2-17) and any calibration study findings.
locked_decisions.W-D-21: RDF parsing for uploaded ontology files uses n3.js (Turtle, N-Triples, N3) and rdfxml-streaming-parser (RDF/XML), both bundled via esbuild. Format detection from extension with content-sniff fallback. New module at src/core/ingestion/ontology-parser.js takes the format-agnostic triple stream and produces D1/D2 pipeline input shape. BFO-specific adapter in src/adapters/integration/ remains unchanged.
locked_decisions.W-D-22: Each scenario in the bundle carries a verification_method field: 'programmatic' (Jest/Node-runnable), 'manual' (requires human visual verification), or 'hybrid' (programmatic data assertion + manual visual check). Programmatic scenarios run in CI from day one. Manual scenarios form the PROV-O Pass 1 dry-run checklist. This split respects the W-D-11 deferral of Playwright/Cypress while still providing day-one coverage for data-layer scenarios.

scenarios.description: Workbench displays three top-level mode tabs: Converse, Ingest, Export. Clicking each navigates to that mode's workspace. Converse and Export from v0.1 remain unchanged; Ingest is new.
Analyst is mid-resolution in Phase 2 Review panel. Switches to Converse, then back to Ingest. State restored: same session active, same panel open, partially-filled justification text preserved.

inProgressForm.note: Partial text preserved, cursor position may or may not be preserved

scenarios.description: Analyst has an active session with resolution work in progress. Page reloads. On reload, the last-active session is visible in Sessions panel, and navigating to the previously-active panel restores the session state.

inProgressForms.note: NOT required to persist across reloads per Rule W-SP-3

scenarios.description: Fresh workbench with zero sessions. Sessions panel shows instructional empty state with 'New Ingestion Session' as the primary action.

verifies: W-2.2 — current phase derived from state
scenarios.description: Three sessions exist with different phase states. Sessions panel lists all three with correct phase badges.
Session with PendingHumanResolution items shows red blocking pill.
Clicking 'New Ingestion Session' creates a new IngestionSession record with a fresh UUID and navigates to Upload panel.

verifies: W-2.5 — clicking session navigates to blocker
scenarios.description: Session has Phase 2 blocking items. Clicking the session card navigates directly to Phase 2 Review panel with that session active.
Upload panel accepts a .ttl file via FileReader. Source preview shows estimated class and property counts.
Upload panel accepts pasted Turtle content. Format auto-detected from content.
Upload panel rejects a file in an unsupported format with a clear error message. Session is not created.

error.note: Error displays specific format and expected formats

verifies: W-3.4 — default configuration visible in advanced panel
scenarios.description: Upload panel's Session Configuration block is collapsed by default. Analyst using defaults is not forced to navigate parameter set.
Analyst modifies weight vector to lexical=0.25 (exceeds 0.10 cap). Start button grays out. Error identifies the offending parameter.
Analyst modifies weights such that Domain + Range + BFO Subcategory = 0.65 (below 0.70 floor). Start button grays out with structural-sum error.

verifies: W-3.6 — Start triggers Phase 1 and navigates
scenarios.description: Start button with valid configuration triggers Phase 1 sandbox, creates staging records and session, records Tau Prolog version, navigates to Phase 1 Review.

verifies: W-3.7 — upload read-only for completed sessions
scenarios.description: When viewing a completed session's Upload panel, inputs and Start button are read-only. Configuration snapshot displayed as information.
Phase 1 Review table displays every CandidateClass record with placement, confidence, status, justification.

stagingRecords.justification: Explicit has_participant signal plus label match

scenarios.description: Expanding a PlacementAmbiguous + PendingHumanResolution row reveals a resolution UI with placement selector and justification textarea.

verifies: W-4.4 — resolution requires both placement and justification
scenarios.description: Analyst selects a placement but leaves justification empty. Confirm button remains disabled. When justification is added, button enables.

actions.text: Bundle is a reified provenance record, generically dependent on its content.

scenarios.description: Analyst completes resolution with justification text. Justification is stored on the CandidateClass record and remains visible (read-only) after resolution.

trigger.justification: Bundle is a reified provenance record.

analystJustification.text: Bundle is a reified provenance record.

verifies: W-4.6 — Phase 2 button grayed out while blocking items remain
scenarios.description: Phase 1 has two PendingHumanResolution items. 'Run Phase 2' button is grayed out. Tooltip names the blocking items.

verifies: W-4.6 — Phase 2 button enables on zero blocking
scenarios.description: After all Phase 1 items resolved, Run Phase 2 button enables. Clicking triggers Phase 2 and navigates.
Phase 2 Review shows two-pane layout: left pane lists CandidateRelation records grouped by disposition, right pane shows detail of selected candidate.

Right pane fingerprint section shows all six dimensions (Domain BFO, Range BFO, BFO subcategory, Characteristics, allowsInheresIn, Lexical) with values and weights. No dimension abbreviated or summarized.
Right pane shows top-N proposed matches with per-dimension contribution breakdown and margins displayed to three decimal places.
When PD-2 forced a candidate score to 0.0 due to disjointness, the disjoint firing is displayed prominently with the disjoint pair identified.

disjointFiringIndicator.text: Disjoint: bfo:Process × bfo:MaterialEntity forced match to 0.0

scenarios.description: DisambiguationRecord case displays four action buttons: Merge, Reject, PromoteAsSubProperty, PromoteAsNewRelation.
Analyst clicks Merge, target picker opens. `owl:topObjectProperty` is not listable. Manual entry of `owl:topObjectProperty` in the override field is rejected with a structured error.
Analyst clicks PromoteAsSubProperty, parent picker + child domain/range picker opens. The child domain selector visibly greys out any BFO node broader than the parent's domain. Tooltip explains why.

options.tooltip: Target broader than parent — not allowed (Invariant I-3, Rule PD-6)

scenarios.description: On sub-property promotion, child's BFO subcategory is auto-filled from parent and is read-only.
Any Phase 2 resolution (Merge, Reject, PromoteAsSubProperty, PromoteAsNewRelation) requires non-empty justification text. Submit disabled otherwise.
Novel Promotion case displays top-3 candidates scored below 0.60 floor for reference (so analyst can see near-misses) but these are not clickable merge targets.

novelPromotionPanel.explanatoryText: No proposed matches above 0.60 disambiguation floor

verifies: W-5.13 — Run Phase 3 button enabled on zero blocking
scenarios.description: After all Phase 2 items resolved, Run Phase 3 button enables. Clicking triggers Tau Prolog sandbox with progress indicator.

verifies: W-6.1 — left pane grouped by violation rule
scenarios.description: Phase 3 Review left pane groups quarantined axioms by violation rule. NoViolations axioms in a separate section.

verifies: W-6.2 — FailureTrace renders all PS-6 required fields
scenarios.description: Selecting a quarantined axiom displays the FailureTrace with all required fields per Rule PS-6 populated.

verifies: W-6.3 — Prolog trace verbatim in monospace
scenarios.description: Prolog trace is displayed in monospace block, verbatim, with Call/Exit/Redo entries preserved. No reformatting, no summarization.
Copy-to-clipboard button next to the Prolog trace emits the exact engine output, suitable for direct paste into the PROV-O report template §5.2.
Suggested repair text is displayed prominently above the fold as a highlighted box. Full text, no truncation.

setup.suggestedRepair: Reclassify :Driver as a bfo:MaterialEntity (e.g., a person) or select a relation type whose range permits processes.

verifies: W-6.7 — Finalize Session navigates to Summary
scenarios.description: Clicking Finalize Session sets sessionCompletedAt, writes Phase 3 summary block, and navigates to Session Summary.
Session Summary displays three cards with counts from IngestionSession phase1Summary, phase2Summary, phase3Summary.

Invariant Audit card displays PS-1 hash equality, PS-2 session ID, PS-9 closure confirmation, PD-2 firing count, PD-10 weight vector, Horn cap, Tau Prolog version. Values displayed concretely, not abstractly.
If PS-1 hashes do not match (implementation bug scenario), Invariant Audit card displays red X. This would indicate a bug, not a study finding.

invariantAuditCard.note: Red X indicates implementation bug — sandbox mutated canonical graph

scenarios.description: Export JSON Bundle button generates a downloadable JSON containing all session artifacts sufficient for PROV-O report Appendix A.

trigger.button: Export Session Artifacts as JSON Bundle

scenarios.description: Download Prolog Traces button generates a separate file with every Phase 3 Prolog trace verbatim, tagged with axiom IRI and violation rule.

verifies: W-7.6 — Export Turtle triggers Export mode
scenarios.description: Export Canonical Graph as Turtle button switches mode to Export with session-scoped context.

verifies: Rule W-EH-1 — parse errors with line/position
scenarios.description: Malformed Turtle upload produces specific line/position error. Session not created. Analyst remains on Upload panel.

verifies: Rule W-EH-3 — invariant firing halts phase
scenarios.description: During Phase 3 execution, PS-1 hash mismatch detected (implementation bug scenario). Phase halts; prominent error banner names the invariant and evidence. Progress disabled until bug is fixed.
All interactive elements are reachable via Tab/Shift-Tab. Resolution forms are fully keyboard-navigable.

verifies: Rule W-A-2 — color not sole carrier
scenarios.description: Status indicators combine color with icon or text label. Color-blind analyst can distinguish PlacementConfirmed, PlacementAmbiguous, PlacementRejected by iconography.
Uploaded file exceeding 1MB (1,048,576 bytes) is rejected with a message explaining the v0.2 scope and pointing to v0.3 for larger ontologies. Session is not created.

error.note: Error message guides user toward v0.3 for larger ontology support

negative_assertions.description: Rejected upload MUST NOT create a partial IngestionSession record, partial staging records, or partial localStorage writes. The Start state is atomic.

scenarios.description: Before session creation, Workbench probes localStorage availability. If available quota is under 2MB (e.g., because existing sessions have filled storage), upload is rejected with guidance to clear older sessions.

error.note: Error guides user to Sessions panel to archive/remove older sessions

scenarios.description: Session with 350 CandidateClass records renders with pagination. Default page size 100. Blocking items surface first regardless of page. Filter operates globally across all pages.

stagingRecords.note: 8 PendingHumanResolution items scattered across what would be 4 pages

firstPageContains.note: Pending items surface first globally, so all 8 appear on page 1

filter.example: Filter 'Rejected' returns all rejected items regardless of page

verifies: W-4.10 — pagination invisible for small ontologies
scenarios.description: Session with 30 CandidateClass records (PROV-O scale) renders without pagination UI. Pagination infrastructure exists internally but is not shown to the user when unnecessary.

table.note: PROV-O fits on one page; pagination controls hidden

scenarios.description: Session with 250 CandidateRelation records renders Phase 2 Review with pagination. Grouping by disposition preserved. PendingHumanResolution items surface first; AutoMerged items paginate normally. Selection navigates right pane regardless of page.

page1Contents.note: Pending items (50) fit on page 1; remaining 150 AutoMerged paginate

verifies: W-5.14 — progress indicator animates during Phase 3
scenarios.description: During Phase 3 execution, progress indicator visibly animates (spinner rotates, counter increments). Implementation chunks axiom evaluations with setTimeout/requestAnimationFrame yielding. A session with 100 axioms shows counter progression '1 of 100', '11 of 100', ... not a frozen spinner.

negative_assertions.description: UI remains responsive during Phase 3 execution — scroll, hover, mode-switch tabs all respond. If any of these freeze for longer than a single chunk's worth of axiom evaluations, the yielding pattern has failed.

scenarios.description: Export JSON Bundle contains a bundle header with schemaVersion, workbenchVersion, fandawsVersion, and generatedAt. v0.2 ships with schemaVersion '1.0'. This enables cross-test comparison across calibration series.

trigger.button: Export Session Artifacts as JSON Bundle

scenarios.description: Viewing Upload panel for a completed session displays Start button replaced with 'Configuration Locked. Start a New Session to change parameters.' text. Not just a greyed button — explicit guidance.

uploadPanel.lockedMessageText: Configuration Locked. Start a New Session to change parameters.

verifies: W-3.11 — owl:imports recorded but not followed
scenarios.description: Upload of PROV-O source containing `owl:imports <http://www.w3.org/2006/time>` declarations. IngestionSession metadata records the import IRIs in a declaredImports field. The import targets are NOT fetched, parsed, or merged into the candidate set. Classes and properties referencing time: IRIs appear as external references in domain/range positions, handled by the pipeline's existing external-reference machinery.

externalReferences.note: time:Instant appears as external IRI in range, not as a candidate class

negative_assertions.description: The parser MUST NOT attempt to fetch, parse, or merge the content of imported ontologies. A session referring to imports does not make a network call or produce candidates from the imported graphs.
References to entities from imported ontologies (e.g., time:Instant in a range) MUST NOT cause session failure. They are preserved as external IRI strings for pipeline handling.

scenarios.description: Workbench v0.2 loaded in a browser with DevTools Network tab recording active. Phase 3 sandbox runs on a session. Inspect Network tab: NO CDN requests for tau-prolog were made. Inspect the loaded bundle: Tau Prolog code is present as bundled ES module. Phase 3 execution produces a genuine Prolog trace (Call/Exit/Redo entries, parseable as Prolog). The trace is byte-identical to what the Node.js AVC test harness produces for the same axiom input.

networkActivity.note: Tau Prolog available without network fetch

negative_assertions.description: Tau Prolog MUST NOT be attached as a window global via script tag injection. It is imported as an ES module from the bundled output.

The Phase 3 sandbox in the browser MUST use actual Tau Prolog, not a JS implementation of Prolog-like resolution. Any scenario asserting 'genuine Prolog trace' (e.g., #36) must produce output indistinguishable from what the Node.js test harness produces for the same axiom input. This is AC-D2-17 carried forward to the browser.

scenarios.description: End-to-end scenario: analyst completes PROV-O Pass 1 using only the UI. Upload, Phase 1 resolution, Phase 2 resolution, Phase 3 review, Session Summary, artifact export. Resulting artifacts sufficient to populate PROV-O report template through §7.

actions.button: Export Session Artifacts as JSON Bundle

reportTemplateSectionsSatisfied.\u00a75.2: filled from Phase 3 Review with verbatim traces

negative_assertions.description: At no point in the end-to-end flow does the analyst open developer console, run commands, or inspect localStorage directly. Every needed artifact is produced by UI action.
Analyst never manually writes or edits JSON to produce artifacts. All artifacts generated by UI with structured export.
